title: OZONOXY 60
pageDescription: Compact ozone generator OZONOXY 60 for room disinfection. Output 60 g/h. Volume up to 2100 m³.
shortDesc: Compact ozone generator for room disinfection with 60 g/h output. Treatable room volume: up to 900/2100 m³.
description: The compact ozone generator OZONOXY 60 is built for room disinfection. It treats up to 900 m³ for total disinfection and up to 2100 m³ for medium contamination. Eliminates unpleasant odors, destroys bacteria and viruses, and combats insects, rodents, mold, and fungus.
features: No nitrogen oxide generation during ozone production
Nominal output can be increased by up to +20% by supplying fresh air to the generator via a flexible duct
Oxygen feed via quick-connect fitting for up to 50% higher output
Metal enclosure with two-stage coating (zinc primer + cured enamel)
Fine filtration — prevents electrode degradation from dust and grease buildup
Multimodal operation — distribute ozone flows across rooms or zones at different times, power levels, and exposure
tasks: disinfection, pest control, rodent control, deodorization, detoxification
